summary: Flathead County, MT platform tower and camp from the 1930s on the Flathead NF; listings say abandoned, not gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says the platform tower is still there and the lookout is abandoned; the FFLA list says Abandoned. No cached source says gone.

evidence.supports: 1930s platform tower and camp on a southwest spur below the summit; abandoned
evidence.quote: 1930s: platform tower (still there), camp. Atop southwest spur 1/2 mile below summit. Abandoned.

evidence.supports: listed as Platform, status Abandoned, coordinates 48.04172 north and 114.81099 west
legal location 26N-25W-3 in the Flathead National Forest
Flathead National Forest, per Forest Lookouts

corrections.why: The cached FFLA list reads Abandoned, not Gone, for this site, and firelookout.com says the platform tower is still there. The brief's ffla=gone conflict does not appear in the cached list.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says the platform tower is still there yet abandoned; the FFLA list says Abandoned. Neither says gone, so status is recorded as unknown until a source describes the site now.

notes_for_editor: Three listings only. Dates are decade-only (1930s), so no events are recorded. No staffing, access or present-day description in any source read. Forest Lookouts page gives only the forest and township. Two WebSearch calls and about six reads used. Kind 'platform' matches both listings.
